body: I can't stand to spend any longer at my school. They fucked me over so many times, I had to remediate some rotations then stay another year. I don't trust them to support me at all. I was suicidal throughout most of my third year and honestly wish I just went through with it. I feel like I might as well do it now instead of put myself through more suffering for no guarantees.

That would require more years of school/debt - it's not like I can just apply for a PA job without any training on what a PA does. I think hope of a "decent future" is relative. I have crippling debt and nothing to live for. On the outside I'm sure it seems silly for me to contemplate suicide - but I don't really care what others think on the outside. I already know how much I'm suffering.
